dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.macro_annuli_edge_geometry: The three most prominent O-shaped structures on the central flank exhibit irregular, high-contrast light-grey perimeters with serrated edges transitioning into dark-grey circular interiors. One prominent C-shaped structure on the anterior lateral section shows a wide opening oriented towards the ventral-anterior direction.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.high_intensity_blob_density: Moderate density of solid light-intensity pixel clusters lacking dark centers is concentrated along the upper-most visible dorsal edge, where patterns appear more compressed and less annular.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.constellation_keypoints: The centroids of the three largest mid-flank annuli form an elongated obtuse triangle with the vertex of the obtuse angle pointing toward the dorsal line. A secondary cluster of three smaller annuli near the flipper region forms a nearly equilateral triangle.

other_distinctive_markers: A unique 'figure-eight' or double-lobed annulus structure is present on the posterior-lateral region, consisting of two fused light-colored rings sharing a partial boundary.
